name: WebAssembly Module Inspector
description: Read-only .wasm analysis: section sizes, imports and exports with signatures, memory and table limits, custom sections, validation and WAT
help: Open or drop a .wasm file. Analysis is offline and read-only: the module is never instantiated or executed, imports are never called and WASI is not emulated.
Section sizes include the id and length fields. The size without custom sections leaves out names, producers and debug info, which is closer to the code that actually ships.

Validation uses the standard validator's default feature set (the WebAssembly 3.0 draft and standardized proposals). Modules that need proposals outside that set are flagged separately from corrupted ones.
WAT is generated on demand: browse the module outline with function bodies folded, or expand functions one by one. Text beyond 64 MB is truncated.
Only core modules are supported for now; component model components are reported as unsupported.
